spec_refs: _GROUNDING.md §9 (CD-TOOLS targeted edits must not duplicate structure)

purpose: Proves that an edit which duplicates a data-disco-comment-anchor id (e.g. by copy-pasting an anchored block during a 'duplicate section' edit) fails the comment-anchor integrity oracle: an anchor id must be unique across the artifact.
required_evidence: count of each data-disco-comment-anchor id before and after
after count > 1 for at least one id (duplicate)
rationale: The new section was created by copying the anchored block, leaving two elements with data-disco-comment-anchor="feature-1". A user comment bound to that id would now be ambiguous. Anchor ids must be unique, so the oracle returns fail.
